✅ Tested for map.apps 4.20.3 / Linie 4

#### Release Notes
- **New:** Added `showDatepickers` option to the TimeSlider widget config. When enabled, a calendar icon appears next to the start/end date labels, opening a datepicker to directly edit the `timeExtent`, bounded by `fullTimeExtent`. Requires `apprt-vue` and `apprt-vuetify` in `allowedBundles`.
- **Fix:** The TimeSlider no longer overwrites the view's or layers' time extent when no `timeExtent` is configured.
- **Sample App:** Reworked the demo around a time-window and an instant TimeSlider layer, added a dark gray canvas basemap (selected by default), enabled the new datepicker option, and set the widget to autoplay/loop on startup.
- Updated to map.apps 4.20.3.
